proof_summary: For \(N=2\cdot100943\cdot3^{39101}-1\), modular exponentiations in the quadratic algebra generated by \(\sqrt{41}\), using the complete factorization \(N+1=2\cdot100943\cdot3^{39101}\), force a chosen element to have exact order \(N+1\) modulo every prime divisor of \(N\). If \(N\) were composite, its least prime divisor \(p\le\sqrt N\) would make this impossible in an algebra of size \(p^2\), so \(N\) is prime and the exponent \(39101\) gives the disproof.
